title: Logarithmic Stability for the Inverse Boundary Problem in Three-Dimensional Isotropic Elasticity
summary: We establish logarithmic stability for the simultaneous recovery of both Lamé parameters in three-dimensional static isotropic elasticity from the full Dirichlet-to-Neumann map. The $L^\infty(Ω)$ estimate holds uniformly on every fixed bounded $C^{22}$ class of uniformly strongly convex coefficients, without prescribed exterior coefficients, agreement of boundary values or derivatives, or smallness assumptions on material gradients.
